name: STORMCAST ETERNALS: LORD-COMMANDER BASTIAN CARTHALOS
description: There is no higher rank in a Stormhost than Lord-Commander, and in the Hammers of Sigmar this esteemed position is held by Bastian Carthalos, the Thunderborn. Once reforged with the power of the ninth Great Bolt, Skjordamar, Carthalos is a master tactician and an indomitable warrior. Sigmar has once again unleashed this mighty warrior to oversee the many crusades undertaken by the Stormcast Eternals. Carthalos has also returned to the battlefield, where he fiercely smites his foes with his legendary warhammer, Uskavar, the Sunderer, while issuing commands to his allies and challenges to his enemies with a voice that booms like a thunderclap. </br></br>This multipart plastic kit comprises 29 components, with which you can build Lord-Commander Bastian Carthalos. You can choose to construct Carthalos holding his warhammer Uskavar in one or two hands, as well as with or without a helmet.</br></br>This kit comes supplied with one 50mm Citadel Round base. This miniature is supplied unpainted and requires assembly – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel paints.
